gate4.rationale: The VCP-expanded consensus improved versus the core baseline but underperformed the current accepted independent-source consensus. Source-set expansions must beat the accepted comparator before retention or adapter promotion.

preflight.alpha_hypothesis: A same-date ticker confirmed by the accepted VCP OHLCV compression sleeve and at least one other accepted free-data source family may have better replacement value than the current accepted independent-source consensus alone.
preflight.playbook_alignment: Uses a broad, free, production-visible default-off paper source family. It avoids LLM soft-ranking, direct SEC text retries, Form 4 retries, and state-surface threshold tuning.
preflight.prior_difference: exp-20260603-014 accepted independent source-family consensus without VCP. This run adds one accepted OHLCV compression source family reconstructed from its original deterministic module rather than retuning source count, thresholds, notional, exits, or hold period.
preflight.reproducibility: The runner persists source-family mapping, reconstructed VCP source-row audit, canonical before/after metrics, target trades, and Gate 4 diagnostics.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A retained lead would need a shared default-off adapter that reconstructs the same VCP source row and independent source-family consensus in both replay and daily run paths before any candidate queue or order surface could change.
